description: This file defines React components related to viewing test files in a web-based test report viewer, including components for displaying multiple test files, headers, and associated UI controls.

methods.name: TestFilesView
methods.description: React functional component that displays a list of test files, manages their expanded/collapsed state, and renders individual TestFileView components.

methods.name: TestFilesHeader
methods.description: React functional component that renders the header section of the test files view, including project info, metadata toggle, and test duration.
